description: Edit image 1 with the help of other images (up to 10 in all) and an instruction, e.g. put the product from image 2 in the hand of the person in image 1. Order matters: refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the prompt. The output follows image 1's aspect ratio unless width/height or aspect_ratio are given. For a new scene that only uses the images as references, use generate_image with reference_images.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, or auto (inferred from the prompt)

image_paths.description: Reference images in order; refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the prompt

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

prompt.description: The edit instruction, written by you in English and used as is (Kokon does not rewrite it): image 1 is the image being changed; start with Place or Combine, say what is taken from each image (image 2, image 3...) and exactly where it goes in image 1, with matching light and shadows, and end with 'Keep everything else in image 1 unchanged.'

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random. Never reuse the seed the source image was generated with: use a different one or omit it

name: edit_images
title: Edit with multiple references
